title: 中国哲学（二）：孟子的思想
subtitle: Chinese Philosophy II · The Thought of Mencius

cards.example: 中国人称孟子为亚圣。
cards.exampleTranslation: Chinese people call Mencius the Second Sage.

cards.example: 孟子是儒家的代表人物。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mencius is a representative figure of Confucianism.

cards.back: the theory that human nature is good
cards.example: 孟子提出了性善论。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mencius proposed the theory that human nature is good.

cards.example: 他主张国君实行仁政。
cards.exampleTranslation: He advocated that rulers practice benevolent governance.

cards.example: 孟子继承了孔子的思想。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mencius inherited Confucius's thought.

cards.example: 仁爱是儒家道德的重要内容。
cards.exampleTranslation: Benevolence is an important part of Confucian morality.

cards.example: 他对道德问题做了理论说明。
cards.exampleTranslation: He gave a theoretical explanation of moral questions.

cards.example: 孟子说人有四端。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mencius said people have four moral beginnings.

cards.example: 恻隐之心就是同情心。
cards.exampleTranslation: The heart of compassion means sympathy.

cards.back: the sense of shame toward wrongdoing
cards.example: 羞恶之心让人知道羞耻。
cards.exampleTranslation: The sense of shame helps people know shame.

cards.back: the heart of modesty and yielding
cards.example: 辞让之心体现了谦让。
cards.exampleTranslation: The heart of yielding reflects modesty.

cards.back: the ability to distinguish right and wrong
cards.example: 是非之心让人分辨善恶。
cards.exampleTranslation: The heart of right and wrong lets people distinguish good from evil.

cards.example: 恻隐之心发展为仁。
cards.exampleTranslation: Compassion develops into benevolence.

cards.example: 羞恶之心发展为义。
cards.exampleTranslation: The sense of shame develops into righteousness.

cards.example: 辞让之心发展为礼。
cards.exampleTranslation: The heart of yielding develops into propriety.

cards.example: 是非之心发展为智。
cards.exampleTranslation: The heart of right and wrong develops into wisdom.

cards.back: do not forget, and do not force growth
cards.example: 培养道德要做到勿忘，勿助长。
cards.exampleTranslation: To cultivate morality, do not forget it and do not force it to grow.

cards.back: to spoil things by rushing for quick results
cards.example: 学习要努力，但不能拔苗助长。
cards.exampleTranslation: You should work hard in learning, but you should not force progress unrealistically.

cards.pinyin: min wei gui, jun wei qing
cards.back: the people are most important, rulers come second
cards.example: 孟子提出了民为贵，君为轻。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mencius proposed that people are most important and rulers come second.

cards.front: 老吾老以及人之老，幼吾幼以及人之幼
cards.pinyin: lao wu lao yi ji ren zhi lao, you wu you yi ji ren zhi you
cards.back: care for others' elders and children as you care for your own
cards.example: 这句话体现了仁政思想。
cards.exampleTranslation: This sentence reflects the idea of benevolent governance.

cards.example: 国君应该对人民有爱心。
cards.exampleTranslation: A ruler should care for the people.

cards.example: 孟子认为朝廷也要重视百姓。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mencius believed the court should also value the common people.

cards.example: 爱人民的人才会受到拥护。
cards.exampleTranslation: Only those who love the people will gain support.

cards.example: 有德的人才有资格当国君。
cards.exampleTranslation: Only virtuous people are qualified to be rulers.
